verdict.rationale: x402 is governed by the Linux Foundation's x402 Foundation, which has forty member organizations, and independent builders implement it: httpay.xyz runs 124 x402 endpoints, Apiosk built an x402-enforcing gateway, Cloudflare proposed new payment schemes, and AWS AgentCore integrates x402 access. Skeptic comments about Coinbase centralization do not concretely contradict that independent implementations exist. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of independent facilitator or SDK implementations (independent implementers are evidenced mainly by community posts, and foundation membership is not proof of implementation).

support.subject: As a developer, at least two independent parties beyond the vendor implement the protocol or platform — it is an ecosystem, not a private integration

citations.quote: x402 is now developed under open, vendor-neutral governance, so the payment layer stays interoperable and free of lock-in to any one provider.
a gateway that enforces per-request x402 payments so API providers can monetize without accounts or keys.
Operator of 124 x402 endpoints at httpay.xyz
Give an AgentCore agent access to x402 services through an AWS Payment Manager and Coinbase CDP connector.
